# Real Ubuntu 26.04.1 desktop ISO fixtures

Captured on 2026-11-25 from `ubuntu-26.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso` (SHA256 601e30fb...a1d1da) via HTTP range reads.
Use these as realistic inputs in tests (grub.cfg rewriting, .disk/info, md5sum format, layered casper listing).
`casper-listing/files.txt` = size + name of every file in `/casper` (language/secureboot variants included).
